text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: billing-metering-alert triggered for prod. Symptom: sudden spike in overage flags and delayed usage emits. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/billing-metering — paging @oncall-ella and @sre-raj

oncall-ella: acked — jumping in, pulling telemetry now. ETA 2m.

sre-raj: I see short windows where token_count > expected by ~2x for 60-90s intervals. Looks like duplicate emitter batches from proxy layer. grep from emitter logs:
```
2026-03-17T18:15:23Z emitter-42 INFO batch_id=abc123 emitted_count=15432
2026-03-17T18:15:23Z emitter-42 INFO batch_id=abc123 emitted_count=15432
```

billing-ana: any customer-facing flags? We're seeing a handful of overage notifications go out (internal test hook). Holding sending further emails until we know scope.

eng-jordan: rolling back recent emitter retry patch to canary (reverted in staging earlier). Pushing a hotfix to disable duplicate-write path.

infra-maya: routing policy change noted in edge-proxy around 18:14 UTC — correlate with deploys? CI shows deploy 18:12 by @eng-jordan (emitter-retry v2.1.4).

cs-liz: we have one paying customer who reported an unexpected overage email via support at 18:20. Customer ID: cust_2374 — tagging to billing to assess crediting.

oncall-ella: mitigation plan: 1) pause downstream overage webhook (billing) 2) disable emitter retry loop (in-flight patch) 3) backfill dedupe job for tokens produced between 18:12-18:22 UTC. Starting step 1 now.

sre-raj: step 1 done — billing webhooks paused. Observability: overage flag rate dropped by ~70% within 30s.

billing-ana: confirm webhook pause, will block notifications and hold manual review queue. Preparing compensation draft for impacted customers.

eng-jordan: deploying hotfix to disable retry dedupe in prod (rolling, 3 nodes at a time). Command: `k rollout restart deployment/emitter --namespace=prod --watch`

incident-bot: NOTE: linked alert IDs: #BILL-4829 #METER-8910. Pager status: acknowledged by oncall-ella.

oncall-ella: hotfix rolled to 50% canary, metrics look stable so far. starting dedupe backfill on a small shard to validate.

sre-raj: quick SQL check for drift window (example):
```sql
SELECT window_start, SUM(tokens_emitted) AS total FROM token_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-17T18:12:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T18:22:00Z'
GROUP BY window_start ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;
-- result: peak window 2026-03-17T18:15:00Z total=3,200,412 expected baseline ~1,500,000
```

billing-ana: flagged affected customers list (internal) — prepping credits and manual emails for anyone with >20% spike.

cs-liz: categorizing customer impact: likely transient overage emails, no data loss. Support playbook: pause charges and set temporary allowance.

infra-maya: dedupe backfill started on shard-7 (batch size 10k). ETA ~12m to validate results.

oncall-ella: will keep this open until backfill completes and counts reconciled. tagging incident commander @sre-raj.

sre-raj: inc-comm ack. next steps: complete backfill, monitor for any residual delayed emits, postmortem after stable.

billing-ana: hold on credits until we confirm final reconciled counts (avoid double-credit). prepping communication draft in #customer-comm.

cs-liz: notified customer success leads. will hold one-off manual outreach for high-touch customers.

eng-jordan: patch fully rolled out to all emitter instances at 18:33 UTC. duplicate write logs absent on tail now.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Alert resolved? Not automatically — please update status when incident is declared mitigated.

oncall-ella: marking mitigated at 18:36 UTC after backfill sample verified. Follow-ups: postmortem, improve canary gating for emitter retries, and add metric for duplicate batch detection.

sre-raj: thanks team — creating incident ticket INC-2026-0317-billing-drift for follow-up actions and RCA.

billing-ana: will summarize customer impact and compensation recommendations in the ticket.

cs-liz: closing loop with support on the manual contact list.

oncall-ella: closing thread — ping if anything pops back up. :thumbsup:
